name: Hornero Moon Phase
description: Moon Phase 2.0: desktop widget and contextual bar indicator for the current moon phase, approximate illumination and derived next new/full moons from the 1.x pure-JS synodic approximation. Always labelled approximate.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Weather & Astronomy 2.0: same synodic approximation as 1.x, plus derived next new/full moon countdowns, illumination progress, contextual bar indicator, configurable density, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog. No PluginKit facade exposes lunar data; every value stays labelled approximate.
Desktop widget showing the current moon phase name and approximate illumination from a pure-JS synodic approximation anchored on the 2000-01-06 new moon.

showIllumination.description: Show the approximate illumination percentage (the 1.x behaviour).

showAge.description: Show the approximate moon age in days (the 1.x behaviour).

showNextPhases.description: Show approximate days to the next new and full moons, derived from the same synodic approximation.

dataDensity.description: compact shows only the phase name; standard keeps the 1.x rows; detailed adds the approximation note.
